description:
The domains competing with any domain in Google: who ranks for the most of the same keywords, how many they share, their average position on those, and each competitor's own organic keyword count and estimated traffic. Big generic sites (Google, YouTube, Wikipedia…) are left out. DataForSEO's Google index; estimates.

Billing: 10¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call again within 24h is free. On the no-account server, a caller without credit gets one data call a day free.

Inputs:
  domain — e.g. "linear.app".
  country — ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, MX, BR); default from the domain's TLD, else US.
  limit — 5–50 competitors, default 20.

Returns { domain, country, competitors: [{domain, shared_keywords, avg_position, shared_keywords_traffic, organic_keywords, estimated_monthly_traffic}], cached, charged_cents }. Feed a competitor to get_domain_keywords to see what it ranks for.

Example: { domain: "linear.app", limit: 10 }

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, MX, BR). Default from the TLD.

name: get_competing_domains
title: A domain's organic search competitors
